name: Project Folder
summary: Interactive React motion block: a folder whose files fan out on hover or focus and expand into an overlay.
description: A free, open-source React and Next.js motion component from beUI's blocks collection. Files fan out of the folder on hover or focus, it expands into a focus-managed overlay and retraces the path when closed; install with the shadcn CLI or copy the source, with props and API reference on the page.
contains: files fan out on hover or focus

API reference: props for open, expanded, previews and itemLabel
